scenes.a: If you are worrying late tonight whether your children will ever walk with God, stay.
Scripture promises, 'Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household.'
Lord, we bring every member of our home into Your presence right now.
Reach into every quiet room of our house and soften hearts that have grown weary or distant.
Surround our children, our spouses, and our relatives with Your holy light and protection.
Fill our household with the deep joy of believing in Your grace together.
We place their lives and their futures into Your faithful hands.
Subscribe to join us daily as we cover our families in prayer.
